basic_details.job_title: DKSCARS Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.post_name: Guest Teacher (Genetics and Plant Breeding, Agricultural Economics)

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for part-time/guest teachers is 40 years. For candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes, and women, age relaxation is admissible up to 5 years as per Chhattisgarh Government rules, provided the maximum age does not exceed 45 years. If the Chhattisgarh Government increases or amends the maximum age limit, those provisions will apply to the guest teachers.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | guest teacher (genetics and plant breeding & agricultural economics): Master degree in relevant subject of Agriculture faculty with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade 6.50 10.00 scales) with good academic record. NET (National Eligibility Test) shall remain compulsory along with one publication in NAAS (National Academy of Agricultural Science, New Delhi) rated referred journal for recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor and equivalent in the disciplines in which NET is conducted. Essentiality of NET can be waved off for the candidates holding Ph.D. Degree provided it has been done with course work as prescribed by the UGC Regulations 2009 and the candidate has at least two full length publication having a NAAS rating not less than the 4, on the last date of submission of application. Those candidates with Ph.D. degree without course work will not qualify for NET exemption.

salary_details.pay_scale: Per day honorarium based on qualifications (Max Rs. 40,000/- per month)
salary_details.guest teacher (ph.d. qualified): Honorarium of Rs. 1,800/- per working day (maximum Rs. 40,000/- per month)
salary_details.guest teacher (net qualified, ph.d. not: Honorarium of Rs. 1,500/- per working day (maximum Rs. 36,000/- per month)
salary_details.details: Guest teachers who have neither Ph.D. nor NET qualification are eligible for an honorarium of Rs. 1,200/- per working day (maximum Rs. 26,000/- per month). Guest teachers are not entitled to any allowances or facilities other than this honorarium.

selection_process: The selection process consists of the scrutiny of application forms followed by an interview for eligible candidates. Notice for interview will be issued separately.

Prepare your bio-data along with all supporting documents. Combine the bio-data and all documents into a single PDF file. Send the single PDF file through email to [email protected]. Ensure the application is submitted on or before 21 October 2026. Await communication regarding the interview schedule after scrutiny of applications.
important_instructions: The contractual appointment is for one year or until a regular appointment is made against the post, whichever is earlier. Eligible applicants will be informed separately for the interview following application scrutiny. Candidates must bring all original documents and self-attested photocopies at the time of the interview. No travel allowance (TA/DA) will be paid to candidates attending the interview. Guest teachers are required to work in accordance with the academic, examination, and laboratory activities instructed by the college from time to time. Detailed rules and regulations for guest teachers can be viewed on the university website via memo numbers referenced in the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is DKSCARS Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DKSCARS Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by Dau Kalyan Singh College of Agriculture and Research Station, Bhatapara, to hire 2 guest teachers on a contract basis for Genetics and Plant Breeding and Agricultural Economics.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DKSCARS Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with 1 vacancy for Genetics and Plant Breeding and 1 vacancy for Agricultural Economics.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DKSCARS Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for DKSCARS Guest Teacher?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master degree in the relevant subject of Agriculture faculty with at least 55% marks along with NET qualification or a Ph.D. degree complying with UGC Regulations 2009 and NAAS rating publication requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for DKSCARS Guest Teacher?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years, with relaxations up to 45 years for reserved categories and women as per Chhattisgarh Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DKSCARS Guest Teacher Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for DKSCARS Guest Teacher vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates must prepare their bio-data and all documents in a single PDF file and email it to [email protected] on or before 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DKSCARS Guest Teacher?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the scrutiny of applications followed by an interview for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly honorarium pay for DKSCARS Guest Teachers?
faq.answer: The honorarium depends on qualifications, offering up to Rs. 40,000/- per month for Ph.D. qualified teachers, up to Rs. 36,000/- per month for NET qualified teachers, and up to Rs. 26,000/- per month for others based on per day rates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the guest teacher appointment at DKSCARS?
faq.answer: The appointment is for a duration of one year or until a regular appointment is made against the post, whichever is earlier.
